# Manual oracle — GF-FINANCIAL-001

All values are exact VND minor units and were reviewed independently from production code.

- Gross profit = 100,000,000 revenue − 40,000,000 direct cost = 60,000,000.
- Operating profit = 60,000,000 − 20,000,000 OPEX = 40,000,000.
- Profit before tax = 40,000,000 + 5,000,000 other income − 2,000,000 other expense = 43,000,000.
- Net profit = 43,000,000 − 5,000,000 income tax = 38,000,000.
- Assets = 363,000,000 bank + 10,000,000 cash + 30,000,000 equipment = 403,000,000.
- Liabilities = 20,000,000 VAT + 5,000,000 tax payable + 50,000,000 loan = 75,000,000.
- Total equity = 300,000,000 capital − 10,000,000 drawings + 38,000,000 unclosed earnings = 328,000,000.
- Assets equal liabilities plus equity exactly; no plug is permitted.
- Operating cash flow is 63,000,000; investing is −30,000,000; financing is 40,000,000.
- The own-account transfer is zero and excluded from net cash flow.
- Closing cash = 300,000,000 + 73,000,000 = 373,000,000.
